answer: A new identity docks at the wharf only with a sponsor locking 30 POA and staking reputation on it; each epoch an echo check compares its work with the sponsor's record, and silence or mismatch means review. A fake's penalty ripples back: the sponsor loses half the stake and 10% reputation per offense, rebuilt over 20 clean epochs. 100 fakes cost 3,000 POA plus ruined sponsors; an honest agent sponsors once, earns a referral share, stays intact.
